name: proton-pass
title: Proton Pass
description: Search, copy and manage credentials from your Proton Pass vaults
author: js0ny

commands.name: search-items
commands.title: Proton Pass Search Items
commands.description: Search items across all Proton Pass vaults

commands.name: list-vaults
commands.title: Proton Pass List Vaults
commands.description: Browse Proton Pass vaults and their items

commands.name: get-totp
commands.title: Proton Pass Get TOTP Codes
commands.description: Get TOTP codes for items in Proton Pass

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: pass-cli path
preferences.description: Path to the pass-cli executable. Leave empty to use pass-cli from PATH.

preferences.name: keyProvider
preferences.title: Key provider
preferences.description: How pass-cli stores encryption keys (PROTON_PASS_KEY_PROVIDER). Auto inherits the environment and lets pass-cli decide.

preferences.name: linuxKeyring
preferences.title: Linux keyring backend
preferences.description: Linux only: keyring backend for PROTON_PASS_LINUX_KEYRING. Auto inherits the environment. Ignored on other platforms.

preferences.name: cacheItems
preferences.title: Cache vault/item metadata
preferences.description: Cache item titles and vault names locally for faster loading. Passwords, notes and TOTP codes are never cached.
preferences.label: Enable metadata cache
